The same refused ask in three deals (three spellings) is one group with n_deals 3 whose representative is the earliest-round ask. perspective is copied into the digest.

part_map.=: our part is present with the same legal effect
part_map.+: our part is present but more protective for perspective.party
part_map.-: our part is present but less protective for perspective.party
part_map.x+: our part is omitted, which is more protective for perspective.party
part_map.x-: our part is omitted, which is less protective for perspective.party
part_map.x0: our part is omitted with no effect on perspective.party

additions.+: an addition no part covers, more protective for perspective.party
additions.-: an addition no part covers, less protective for perspective.party
additions.0: an addition no part covers, neutral for perspective.party

label_by.parts: the default, so a digest entry omits label_by: the label is derived from the part map and additions; reason is the judgment's most important difference
label_by.owner: the owner set the label over the judged part map and additions, which may imply another label; reason is the owner's and wins

settled.agreed: an independent blind check reached the same label and parts as the judgment
settled.adjudicated: the blind check disagreed and a fresh agent decided: the judgment shown is that decision, so this label was contested and deserves more scrutiny
settled.unchecked: no completed blind check (none yet, or a disagreement still awaiting adjudication): weaker evidence than agreed or adjudicated
settled.owner: the owner set or corrected the judgment; it is never blind-checked
